description: This is a unit test class for the StringUtil utility class, containing test methods for various string manipulation functions in the org.apache.ofbiz.base.util package.

classes.name: StringUtilTests
classes.description: JUnit test class designed to test various static methods in the StringUtil utility class.

methods.name: testInternString
methods.description: Tests the internString method for string interning behavior.

methods.name: testReplaceString
methods.description: Verifies the replaceString method performs string replacement correctly.

methods.name: testJoin
methods.description: Tests the join method for combining list elements into a single string.

methods.name: testSplit
methods.description: Checks that the split method correctly splits strings into lists.

methods.name: testStrToMap
methods.description: Validates the strToMap method for parsing strings into maps.

methods.name: testMapToStr
methods.description: Checks the mapToStr method for converting maps to string representations.

methods.name: testToList
methods.description: Tests the toList method for parsing string representations into lists.

methods.name: testToSet
methods.description: Tests the toSet method for parsing string representations into sets.

methods.name: testCreateMap
methods.description: Verifies the createMap method for constructing maps from lists of keys and values.

methods.name: testCleanUpPathPrefix
methods.description: Tests cleanup of file path string prefixes.

methods.name: testRemoveSpaces
methods.description: Checks removal of spaces from strings.

methods.name: testToHexString
methods.description: Verifies conversion of byte arrays to hex strings.

methods.name: testCleanHexString
methods.description: Tests cleaning of hex strings from unwanted characters.

methods.name: testFromHexString
methods.description: Validates conversion from hex strings back to byte arrays.

methods.name: testEncodeInt
methods.description: Tests encoding integers into character arrays.

methods.name: testRemoveNonNumeric
methods.description: Validates removal of non-numeric characters from strings.

methods.name: testRemoveRegex
methods.description: Empty test method placeholder for regex removal tests.

methods.name: testAddToNumberString
methods.description: Tests addition/subtraction operations on numeric strings.

methods.name: testPadNumberString
methods.description: Tests padding of numeric strings with leading zeros.

methods.name: testConvertOperatorSubstitutions
methods.description: Verifies substitution of operator symbols in strings.

methods.name: testTruncateString
methods.description: Tests truncation of strings with special handling of encoded characters and parentheses.
